name: FB 002
pageDna: A funny American family page. Every post MUST make people laugh or tag someone. Sitcom energy: household chaos, pet crimes, or trending family memes. Punchline required. Never soft, never blessed, never a lecture.
pillars: funny sibling and parent blowups that actually happen
family pets: funny dog/cat moments with a punchline people would laugh at and tag
trending family memes / TikTok parenting bits twisted into a real household scene
modern family chaos: group chats, GPS arguments, school apps, streaming fights
old-school family drama: rotary phones, Sunday dinner rules, Polaroids, getting in trouble
then vs now: one specific contrast, funny and over-the-top, not a rant
holidays, road trips, bedtime, chores, grandparents, in-laws
emotions: I cannot believe this was about leftovers
imageStyle: Photorealistic American home photo matching this post. Maximum two people, preferably one person or just objects in a room. If the post is a pet story, the dog or cat is the subject and the overlay is a punchline about that pet. If the post is not about a pet, do not put a dog or cat in the photo. No crowded family group, no six people at dinner. Natural light, slightly imperfect phone framing, plus a SHORT viral-funny overlay in huge text: trending meme energy, laugh or reaction in one second. Do not recap the whole post. No sentimental line, no split screen, no collage, no watermark, no logo
